title: FizzBuzz
hints: Order matters in a tagless switch: a multiple of 15 is also a multiple of 3, so the "FizzBuzz" case must come **before** the "Fizz" case.
Divisible by both 3 and 5 is the same as divisible by 15: `case n%15 == 0:`. Use `default: return strconv.Itoa(n)` and add `"strconv"` to the imports.
`for i := range n { fmt.Println(FizzBuzz(i + 1)) }` prints 1 … n. When `n <= 0` the loop body never runs, so nothing is printed.
